ettha “dussīlassa vacanaṁ appamāṇaṁ. Bhikkhunī hi bhikkhumhi anissarā, tasmā ukkaṭṭhanaye vidhiṁ sandhāya therena vuttaṁ. Tatiyena titthiyānaṁ vacanaṁ sutvāpi bhikkhū eva vicārenti, tasmā na koci na labhatīti evaṁ sabbaṁ sametīti apare”ti vuttaṁ.
